text:
Asha (CSM): Heads up — kickoff for the Renewal Sentinel prep for Meridia. Need slide owners, enablement asks, and a short exec dry-run window. Can we sync on who owns which piece?

Diego (Account Exec): I can own the exec readout + pricing ask. Planning a 7-min slot. :thumbsup:

Nora (Solutions Eng): I'll own the technical health slide and onboarding gaps. I have two demos to surface (KV cache perf + rollout timeline).

Len (RevOps): I'll pull unit economics and the renewal risk signal dashboard. Will need clear token/cost breakdowns by model route.

Asha (CSM): Great. Slide owners so far: Exec/readout = Diego, Tech/onboarding = Nora, Econ = Len. Need: enablement asks (what we want from product/solutions), customer success risks page, and a single slide with mitigation steps.

Mira (CS Ops): I can draft the mitigation slide and capture feedback items from the last onboarding retro. Quick Q: do we want the demo clips embedded or links to Loom? Demo clips add time.

Nora (Solutions Eng): Recommend links + 30s clips for the KV perf. Saves deck size. I'll upload Looms and short notes.

Asha (CSM): Perfect. Can we set a dry-run: Thursday 10:00am PT for a 20-min run? Need Diego + Len + Nora + me.

Diego (Account Exec): Thursday 10 works. I'll prep the pricing scenario slide with two options (standard renewal / accelerated commit).

Len (RevOps): I'll push the cost breakdown and a sensitivity table. Will need the calls per-minute numbers — @Nora can you confirm the average sequence length for Meridia?

Nora (Solutions Eng): Average seq ~ 420 tokens, tail at ~1.2k for support threads. I'll add a short note in the econ slide for tail latency impact.

Asha (CSM): Action items (quick):
- Diego: exec readout + pricing slides (draft by Wed EOD)
- Nora: tech + demo Looms (draft by Wed EOD)
- Len: econ + risk dashboard export (draft by Wed noon)
- Mira: mitigation slide + feedback capture doc (draft by Wed EOD)
- me: stitch deck, run dry-run Thurs 10am PT

slidebot: uploaded slide skeleton -> https://slides.redwood/example-meridia (owner: Asha)

Mira (CS Ops): I'll start a simple feedback doc and tag customers' last-touch notes. Will surface 3 top friction points.

Diego (Account Exec): Also adding an ask: 2-week technical office hours post-renewal. Put it as a canary mitigation — note for the exec ask.

Len (RevOps): Noted. Also running a quick sensitivity sim — if burst traffic doubles, estimated cost delta +18-22%. I'll include a small chart.

Asha (CSM): Nice. If everyone can drop their draft slides in the skeleton by Wed EOD I'll consolidate. Dry-run Thurs 10am PT, link will be in calendar invite. :eyes:

Nora (Solutions Eng): Copy. Will tag relevant commands / config snippet in the notes, e.g.:
```
# sample batch config
batch_size: 32
max_seq: 1200
cache_prefix: enabled
```

Diego (Account Exec): Thx. If anything shifts ping here.

Asha (CSM): Thanks team — going to set the invites and mark owners in the deck. If you can't hit Wed EOD please call out asap.
